summary.text: Dexter Bland, also known as Dizzy, is the Independent Party of Delaware candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Bland described himself as a husband, father, small business owner and lifelong Delawarean who owns a local moving company.

paragraphs.text: Dexter Bland earned a high school diploma from Howard High School of Technology, and his Ballotpedia profile lists his profession as businessman.
Bland also sought election to the U.S. Senate from Delaware as an unaffiliated candidate but will not appear on that general election ballot.
In the survey, Bland said he has hired directly from the community he wants to serve through his moving company.
Bland named public education, economic advancement and affordability as the center of his campaign.
He said he is passionate about protecting young people from abuse, including in the education system, and about addressing gun violence and trafficking affecting youth.
He said he is running as an independent because good ideas are not owned by any political party.
